product_overview: Cálculo de Horas is a client-side web tool for calculating service costs based on worked hours, day types, and surcharge rules. It also supports weekly reporting, payment liquidation generation, and local record history management.
core_goals: Calculate the cost of a single work order from time and rate inputs
Generate a consolidated weekly report from up to 7 days of work
Assemble payment states with extra costs and printable liquidation output
Review, modify, delete, export, and import stored calculation records

features.name: Work Order Calculation
features.description: Lets the user calculate the service cost for a single day of work using day type, time range, rate, surcharge, minimum hours, and meal break rules.
user_flows: Navigate to /ordenes.html -> Select a day type -> Enter a start time -> Enter an end time -> Choose or enter an hourly rate -> Select a surcharge percentage -> Select minimum guaranteed hours -> Optionally enter meal break minutes and choose how the discount applies -> Calculate the result -> View the detailed breakdown of service hours, operator hours, and total cost

Navigate to /ordenes.html -> Select a day type -> Enter a start time -> Enter an end time -> Choose or enter an hourly rate -> Select a surcharge percentage -> Select minimum guaranteed hours -> Calculate the result -> Enter an index number -> Save the record
Navigate to /ordenes.html -> Make changes to the entered values -> Clear the form -> See the form reset to its initial state

features.name: Weekly Report Calculation
features.description: Allows the user to enter and calculate a weekly summary across seven days, with global rate and surcharge settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /reportes.html -> Enter start and end times for one or more days from Monday to Sunday -> Select which days are included -> Set the global hourly rate -> Set the global surcharge percentage -> Set the global minimum guaranteed hours -> Calculate the report -> View the consolidated weekly totals

Navigate to /reportes.html -> Enter start and end times for one or more days from Monday to Sunday -> Select which days are included -> Set the global hourly rate -> Set the global surcharge percentage -> Set the global minimum guaranteed hours -> Calculate the report -> Enter an index number -> Save the report record

features.name: Payment State Management
features.description: Lets the user combine stored orders or reports, add extra cost items, enter company details, and generate a printable liquidation PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /pagos.html -> Enter one or more record index numbers -> Load the records into the payment state -> View the aggregated hours and amounts -> Enter extra cost item details -> Enter company name, address, and contact information -> Provide a logo URL -> Review the live total with IVA -> Generate the liquidation PDF

Navigate to /pagos.html -> Enter one or more record index numbers -> Load the records into the payment state -> View the aggregated hours and amounts -> Enter extra cost item details -> Enter company name, address, and contact information -> Provide a logo URL -> Review the live total with IVA -> Save the payment state with an index number

features.name: Record History
features.description: Provides a searchable history of stored orders and reports, with viewing, editing, deleting, exporting, and importing of saved records.
user_flows: Navigate to /historial.html -> View the table of stored records -> Search by index number -> Filter records by type -> Open a record to view its details in a modal
Navigate to /historial.html -> Find a stored record -> Choose to modify it -> Go to the corresponding calculator page -> Edit the record data -> Save the updated record
Navigate to /historial.html -> Find a stored record -> Choose to delete it -> Confirm the deletion -> See the record removed from history
Navigate to /historial.html -> Export the stored records as JSON -> Download the file
Navigate to /historial.html -> Import a JSON file -> Merge the imported records into the existing history

routes.description: Individual work order calculator - calculate service hours and costs
Weekly report - consolidated calculation for all 7 days
Payment states - aggregate orders/reports, add extra costs, generate PDF
Record history - view, modify, delete, export/import stored records

features.name: Work Order Calculation
features.description: Calculate service costs for a single work day with configurable day type, time range, hourly rate, surcharge percentage, minimum guaranteed hours, and meal break discount
user_interactions: Select day type from dropdown (Normal/Saturday/Sunday-Holiday)
Enter start time (HH:MM)
Enter end time (HH:MM)
Select hourly rate value from predefined options or enter custom
Select surcharge percentage (0%/10%/20%/30%)
Select minimum guaranteed hours
Optionally enter meal break minutes and select if discount applies to surcharge or non-surcharge hours
Click Calcular button to compute results
View detailed breakdown of service hours, operator hours, and total cost
Enter index and click Guardar Registro to save
Click Limpiar to reset form

features.name: Weekly Report Calculation
features.description: Consolidated weekly report with 7-day input, global hourly rate and surcharge settings, with totals
user_interactions: For each day (Mon-Sun), enter start time and end time
Toggle which days are included via checkboxes
Set global hourly rate
Set global surcharge percentage
Set global minimum guaranteed hours
Click Calcular to generate weekly report
View consolidated totals for the week
Enter index and click Guardar to save

features.name: Payment State Management
features.description: Aggregate existing orders/reports, add extra cost items, upload company logo, and generate printable PDF liquidation
user_interactions: Add records by entering index number
View aggregated hours and amounts
Add extra cost items with name, quantity, and unit price
Enter company data (name, address, contact)
Upload company logo via URL
View live total with IVA (19%)
Click Generar Liquidación to create printable PDF
Enter index and save payment state

features.name: Record History
features.description: View all stored records with search, filter, modify, delete, and JSON import/export capabilities
user_interactions: View table of all stored records
Search by index number
Filter by type (Order/Report)
Click Ver to view record details in a modal
Click Modificar to edit a record (redirects to calculator)
Click Eliminar to delete a record (with confirmation)
Click Exportar JSON to download all records
Click Importar JSON to upload and merge records

known_limitations.issue: No server-side persistence, all data stored in localStorage only
known_limitations.impact: Data is browser-specific and can be lost if localStorage is cleared

known_limitations.issue: Sidebar HTML duplicated across all 5 HTML files
known_limitations.impact: Any sidebar change must be replicated across every HTML file

known_limitations.issue: No test suite or linting configured
known_limitations.impact: No automated quality checks or regression testing
